title: Infinitely many multi-peaks solutions for a nonlinear Hartree system
summary: In this paper, we study the following nonlinear Hartree system: $-Δu_i + V_i(x)u_i = μ_i φ_{u_i}u_i + \sum_{j\neq i}β_{ij}φ_{u_j}u_i$ for $x\in\mathbb{R}^3$, with $u_i\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$ ($i=1,2,3$), where $φ_u(x):=\int_{\mathbb{R}^3}\frac{u^2(y)}{|x-y|}dy$ for any $u\in H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$, $V_i(x)$ ($i=1,2,3$) are continuous bounded radial functions, and $β_{ij}$ are coupling constants. We mainly investigate the effects of the potentials and the nonlinear coupling terms on the structure of solutions.
